title: Imagine everyone can build their own automated trading bot/system—let's talk about it
author: Pupsi42069
selftext:
How long can this go on? Institutional investors have been using algorithms for years, on a scale that moves the markets. Now there are X new players entering the fray who analyze the market just as “well” and place their bets based on sophisticated algorithms. Where is this headed?

Not everyone can have a piece of the pie. There have to be some who don’t get a piece—it can’t be any other way. One person’s gain is another’s loss.

Let’s say: We have about 5 years left (though it feels like much less) during which a manageable, small number of new traders will use an AI to create a profitable trading system. After that, an even larger number of traders will enter the market—because getting started will be even easier. 

Today, after reading this thread, we know that developing such a system is still a bit tricky, especially if you’re not an expert—much like the difference between programming and Vibe Coding. 

But it's only a matter of time before this problem is solved.

What then?  
How do you think the (trading) market will react to these new circumstances?  
What adjustments will be made?

  
/Transparency
